_meta._note: Wave 8 — CASP12-15 protein folding GDT-TS progression backfill (Phase 2A: CASP13 + CASP15 primary-source scores added). STRICT-ATTRIBUTION: each (model_id, benchmark_id, value) triple must be visible together on a primary source. Verified scores: (1) CASP13 / AlphaFold v1 = 58.9 median GDT_TS on FM domains, primary source Senior et al. 2019 'Protein structure prediction using multiple deep neural networks in the 13th CASP' Proteins 87(12) prot.25834 — quote: 'AlphaFold achieved a median score of 58.9 on the CASP free-modeling category, ahead of 52.5 and 52.4 by the two next best-placed teams.' (2) CASP14 / AlphaFold2 = 92.4 median GDT overall, DeepMind blog announcement Nov-30-2020 (already ingested in earlier wave). (3) CASP15 / AlphaFold2 = ~73 average GDT_TS on 94 CASP15 domains, primary source Liu et al. 2023 'Improving AlphaFold2-based protein tertiary structure prediction with MULTICOM in CASP15' Communications Chemistry s42004-023-00991-6 — quote: 'standard AlphaFold2 predictor … average GDT-TS ~0.73 on 94 CASP15 domains.' CASP12 top-group average GDT_TS was NOT verifiable from primary sources within the strict-attribution rule (predictioncenter.org publishes z-scores not raw GDT_TS averages, and per-target peaks like BAKER-ROSETTASERVER GDT_TS=81.1 on T0892-D1 are single-target not aggregate); CASP12 benchmark stub remains for future ingest. Newly registered model: google-deepmind/alphafold-1 (DeepMind's CASP13 winner, 2018).

scores._note: Senior et al. 2019 'Protein structure prediction using multiple deep neural networks in CASP13', Proteins 87(12) prot.25834 (companion to AlphaFold-v1 Nature 2020 s41586-019-1923-7). AlphaFold (group A7D, DeepMind) achieved median GDT_TS = 58.9 on CASP13 free-modeling (FM) domains — first place, ahead of 52.5 and 52.4 by the two next best-placed teams. Overall median GDT_TS across all CASP13 targets was 68.5 (not used here; this benchmark is FM-only). Cross-confirmed by Wikipedia AlphaFold article and DeepMind CASP13 retrospective.

DeepMind official CASP14 announcement blog (Nov 30 2020): 'In the results from the 14th CASP assessment, released today, our latest AlphaFold system achieves a median score of 92.4 GDT overall across all targets.' Median GDT_TS across all CASP14 targets, AlphaFold2 group 427. Also reported in companion Nature paper s41586-021-03819-2 (Jumper et al. 2021).

Liu et al. 2023 'Improving AlphaFold2-based protein tertiary structure prediction with MULTICOM in CASP15', Communications Chemistry s42004-023-00991-6 (also PMC10484931). Reports the standard AlphaFold2 predictor achieved average GDT-TS ~0.73 on 94 CASP15 domains — i.e. 73.0% on the GDT_TS [0,100] scale used in this DB. The MULTICOM_refine variant (top-3 server in CASP15) reached ~0.80 avg GDT-TS on the same 94-domain set, 9.6% improvement over standard AlphaFold2. CASP15 was substantially harder than CASP14 (more targets with novel folds / scarce MSAs), explaining the drop from 92.4 (CASP14) → 73.0 (CASP15) for the same model class.
